# Marius Minia | Developer, Designer & Senior IT Trainer

> Marius Minia is a developer, designer, senior IT trainer and coach in Romania. He helps developers grow technically and design software with greater structure, clarity and confidence.

## How Marius helps

- [Developer coaching](https://marius93rm.github.io/#services): Practical support for technical growth, code review, software architecture, testing and engineering decisions.
- [Software design and UX/UI](https://marius93rm.github.io/#services): Clearer interfaces, design systems and software that is easier to understand, use and maintain.
- [Web development and technical support](https://marius93rm.github.io/#services): Help building or improving projects with React, JavaScript, Node.js, Laravel, PHP, C#/.NET, Python and SQL.

## Courses taught by Marius Minia

- [Courses and training experience](https://marius93rm.github.io/#teaching): Marius has personally taught professional courses and developer academies covering React, JavaScript, Node.js, Laravel, PHP, C#, .NET, Java, Spring, Python, SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, Storybook and Figma, with a focus on software quality and practical application.

## Selected work

- [Software and web projects](https://marius93rm.github.io/#work): Websites, developer tools and product experiments shaped around clear interfaces, accessibility, performance and maintainable code.

## Background

- [Engineering, product design and teaching](https://marius93rm.github.io/#background): Computer Engineering studies at Sapienza University of Rome, the Apple Developer Academy and professional certifications.
